note: Phase 25 design log (docs/extreme90_phase25.md). Budget fixed before drafting: up to 8 substantive revisions per concept after its first draft; every draft benched with tools/ta90_bench24.gd; full checks by tools/extreme90_eval25.py.

Q1.name: Sequence-pusher crate relay (movable + sequence)

drafts.result: core: tapping a Sequence pusher before the crate reaches its lane wastes its one push (4-6 moves later); 2 distinct, 7 moves
unsolvable (P2 and P4 second arrows face each other on row 6)
P4 exits outward: solvable, but the route stops after 2 pushes (P3, P4 idle)
column-2 and row-2 blockers that would push the crate back: 4 distinct, greedy 0.017, 11 moves, late 0.64
row-1 block: 12 moves, 8 steps; it just leaves first
row-1 walled in by the column block: 5 distinct, 10 steps, coverage 0.83, late 0.83, greedy 0.04; 12 moves (< 13)
unsolvable (two row-1 blocks facing each other)
fifth push stage (U a Sequence pusher, K in column 3): 14 moves, 5 distinct; late 0.71, filler 2 (V r1c2, W r2c6)
filler removed: 5 distinct, 9 steps, coverage 0.75, late 0.75, greedy 0.083, 12 moves (< 13)
a free column-4 block: 13 moves but REJECTED - TIME UP 45.8 ms (> 40)
K a Sequence block: it pushes the crate itself - the fifth stage is bypassed (3 distinct, greedy 0.41)

H a Sequence block (one forced extra move): HUMAN-REVIEW CANDIDATE, 5 distinct, 13 steps, coverage 0.87, 15 moves, greedy 0.167, 0 filler, overlap 0.32, TIME UP 9.8 ms. NOT SELECTED: conceptual duplicate of N44 (the Sequence pusher: a push also advances the pusher's arrow; 'tapping early wastes the push' is one of N44's own mistakes)

Q1.outcome: Q1l kept as a PROVISIONAL candidate (re-examined: same mechanic insight as N44, new structure - a relay of one-shot pushers with a shuttle; judged by the standard applied to N52 vs N48; flagged as a novelty risk)

drafts.result: IMPOSSIBLE under the current rules: a magnet must be a plain arrow on a board without portals, crates or hidden blocks (LevelManager validation) - the reason crate + magnet and magnet + portal never occur in the bank

G1.name: crate brake and shuttle (movable + gate + switch + lock)

drafts.result: trivial: the switch frees everyone, the crate never has to move
blockers on the crate's route are free from the start and simply leave first: 2 distinct, greedy 0.59
shuttle with a gate brake: one reversal lets the right pusher push the crate LEFT at once - the right-hand excursion is bypassed: 2 distinct

G1.outcome: stopped after 3 drafts: every crate design needs a forcing element per waiting block; set aside for the hybrid path
